task_intent: Refine Tessera’s discovery, imagination, and listening features with expressive native interfaces and reliable wall feedback.

references.name: WhatsApp / Meta AI voice call
references.applied: One visually quiet listening focal point and clear microphone action. Tessera uses a real level-driven horizon instead of an unrelated orb.

references.name: Meta AI voice response
references.applied: Readable spoken-text transcript, prominent current state, and an immediately available type alternative. The app shows the actual panel frame alongside state feedback.

references.name: Apple Human Interface Guidelines / Feedback
references.applied: Integrate confirmation and errors into the surface, with semantic VoiceOver announcements on meaningful state changes. Haptics follow confirmed actions.

references.name: Apple Human Interface Guidelines / Progress indicators
references.applied: Preserve a stable place for status, use determinate six-take and ten-second enrollment progress, and explain stalled microphone/connection states.
